levels.surface: أبي عبد الله جعفر بن محمد

notes: The opening «وعن» points back to prev1 (Ibn Ya'qub's chain, which writes no name that «محمد بن يحيى» stands on); how much it takes over is not settled, so the back_reference is written as it stands
«7 -» is the report number. The Imam after «عن» (أبي عبد الله جعفر بن محمد) is a narrator, named inside the chain (owner ruling 2); the sermon is the saying
